description: Hand-authored synthetic desktop-memory relevance fixture. Fictional names/commitments. Not a natural-user corpus or vendor comparison. No-evidence queries measure candidate false positives, not generative abstention.

documents.title: Release checklist
documents.text: Maya owns the OSwind release checklist. Ship on Friday after the signing and restore checks pass.

documents.title: Energy investigation
documents.text: Capturing identical frames wastes energy. Skip near duplicates, pause when idle, and increase the sampling interval when the laptop gets hot.

documents.title: Acme refund request
documents.text: Acme wants the unused annual subscription refunded. Jordan will send the credit receipt once finance approves it.

documents.title: Acme renewal discussion
documents.text: Acme agreed to renew for twelve months, provided the new contract keeps the current per-seat rate through March. Avery owns the revised agreement.

documents.title: Sunday dinner
documents.text: Roast cauliflower, then dress it with tahini, lemon juice and cumin. Sprinkle parsley on top and serve with flatbread.

documents.title: Seattle conference
documents.text: The Seattle flight departs Tuesday at 09:00. The hotel allows check-in after 15:00. Remember the demo laptop and HDMI adapter.

documents.title: Sign-in redirect
documents.text: Users return to the sign-in page because the session cookie uses SameSite=Strict. Update the authentication callback cookie policy.

documents.title: Customer discovery
documents.text: Jamie asked for meeting transcripts that work without an internet connection and citations that open the original source. Theo will build a prototype by Monday.

documents.title: Retrieval design
documents.text: Combine BM25 lexical ranking with vector cosine similarity using reciprocal rank fusion. Keep model versions separate and rebuild derived vectors when text changes.

documents.title: Retention decision
documents.text: Delete recorded material after thirty days. Exclude password managers and banking domains before saving screenshots. Private activity must be pausable.

documents.title: Interface review
documents.text: Use a quiet mint accent and readable typography. Keep the pause control visible, including when only the microphone is recording.

documents.title: Invoice 4821
documents.text: Acme invoice 4821 is due November 12. Jordan should receive the receipt after the transfer clears. This is unrelated to the renewal agreement.

documents.title: Local speech recognition
documents.text: Whisper base.en converts captured speech to text on the Mac. Metal acceleration speeds inference; silent chunks should not create invented transcripts.

documents.title: Recovery drill
documents.text: Restore the encrypted archive into a fresh temporary directory. Verify image checksums, transcript counts, and source links before switching to the restored store.

documents.title: Vet visit
documents.text: Pepper needs a rabies booster on Saturday. Bring the vaccination record to the veterinary clinic.

documents.title: Reading notes
documents.text: The book discusses spaced repetition and retrieval practice. Testing memory strengthens later recall more than rereading the same passage.

documents.title: SQLite contention
documents.text: A long transaction held the writer lock while a model request was running. Move network inference outside database transactions and use short compare-and-save writes.

documents.title: External display bug
documents.text: On the second monitor, captured text is blurry at the current scale. Compare native pixel dimensions with logical window bounds before setting capture resolution.

documents.title: Local server isolation
documents.text: The memory API must bind to loopback, require a random bearer token and reject unexpected browser origins. Do not expose the archive on the local network.

documents.title: Unrelated launch checklist
documents.text: Theo owns the Atlas launch checklist. It ships on Thursday, after marketing approves the announcement. Atlas is not OSwind.

documents.title: Mint paint
documents.text: The bicycle frame will use mint paint and cream tires. Its brake lever needs replacing before the weekend ride.

documents.title: Bank transfer
documents.text: The supplier transfer should clear on Tuesday. Check the bank statement before paying the same bill again.

documents.title: Contrato de soporte
documents.text: La renovación del soporte de Boreal será por seis meses. Lucía preparará el contrato nuevo antes del miércoles. No cambia el precio.

documents.title: Comida del equipo
documents.text: La reserva para comer con Priya es el jueves a mediodía en un restaurante italiano. Hay cuatro personas confirmadas.

documents.title: Train pour Lyon
documents.text: Le train pour Lyon part vendredi à 18 h 20. Camille doit apporter les billets et la réservation de l’hôtel.

documents.title: Gartenplanung
documents.text: Die Tomaten brauchen morgens Wasser. Am Sonntag pflanzt Lena die Setzlinge in die großen Töpfe auf dem Balkon.

documents.title: 翻訳レビュー
documents.text: 日本語版の説明書は金曜日までに直します。担当は美咲です。アプリのリリース日とは別の予定です。

documents.title: 设计会议
documents.text: 设计会议决定先修复键盘导航，再增加新的主题。王林负责在星期二之前完成焦点顺序的测试。

documents.title: Yesterday’s scope
documents.text: Yesterday the team considered delaying OSwind until next month. That proposal was superseded by today’s Friday release decision.

documents.title: Current release decision
documents.text: Today the team confirmed OSwind will ship this Friday. Maya still owns the readiness checklist.

documents.title: Support ticket
documents.text: A customer cannot find saved screenshots from last week. Ask them to widen the date filter and check their configured retention period.

documents.title: Setup troubleshooting
documents.text: Screen Recording permission allows pixels to be captured. Accessibility allows reading app structure and browser context. Microphone access is separate.
